concern_summary: This concern encompasses the entire flow of managing a report draft, including updating comments, validating draft properties, and checking the existence of drafts. It ensures that any modifications, validations, and status checks are cohesively handled during the report field list type creation process.
This concern focuses on the editing, updating, and deletion of report fields and ensuring that any changes reflect the appropriate actions in relation to report policies and user interactions.
This concern involves interactions with the report field types, validating their selection and updating properties based on the requirements of other functionalities and user input.
Management and configuration of settings related to the creation flow of report field list types, including feature toggles and custom settings.
This concern revolves around the retrieval and formatting of reimbursement report data and synchronizing information across different accounting systems.
This functionality is responsible for managing lists of reports related to money requests, creating or updating reports based on transaction contexts.
Handling list values associated with report fields, focusing on selection, validation, and user interactions for managing these values.

This concern encapsulates the functionalities related to evaluating and managing report totals within the context of the report field list type creation flow, specifically focusing on approval limits and forwarding actions.
This concern involves generating and managing the overall workflow and actions related to Money Reports, with a specific focus on reporting processes and retrieving related money request actions.
